rows.name:
Thank you for everything, mo! Morumo will
make Formide Shopping Street the greatest
commercial city, surpassing the Pignerator
Trade Guild, mo!

Thanks to everyone, Obibi's shop is
booming, mo! If you ever need clothes or
hats, please visit Obibi's Textiles, mo!

Thanks to everyone, Tekuteku's nationwide
training journey is going smoothly, mo!
Tekuteku wants to do business with you again,
learn lots, and return to Fortis Trade Guild, mo!

The shelter we built underground should
withstand even fierce attacks. We'll protect
this town, so you can fight without worrying
about us.

Thanks for cheering Joey up. My goal is for
everyone to get along and play together
happily. I need to work hard like Laura-san,
too.

Thanks for bringing the Armus back. I won't
do any more strange experiments! Still, why
does Tiko have to meddle so much? I don't
know how to react.

It's great that I'm all better now, but
the best thing is that my mum isn't
sad anymore. Thanks for making her
smile again.

Gwahaha! To think the Iiran army had two
such excellent gatekeepers! But we still need
more talented people. Of course, you'd all be
welcome anytime!

Thanks to all of you, Squad Leader Onyx
acknowledged me. But somehow the person I most
want recognition from still doesn't seem to
see it.

Thanks for helping me understand
Calcedo's true feelings. We'll
continue to guard the peace as
brothers- no, as comrades.

Thank you for helping my grandmother. Lately
she seems to enjoy her walks along Imperial Forest Road more and more.

I can't keep relying on Chairman Morumo.
From now on, I'll work hard so I can contribute
to Formide Shopping Street myself!

You helped Chairman Morumo, didn't you? If
there's anything I can do, just say the word.
Anything except haggling over prices.

I'll treasure the courage to trust others that
you gave me as I go on living. And let me say
it again—thank you for helping me realize it.

Thank you for helping Chairman Morumo. I can
still run my instrument shop because of him.
He's my benefactor. I'll be cheering you on
with all I've got, too!

Everyone encouraged me so much,
I feel a lot more confident now! I'm
gonna keep learning about insects and
machines until I'm an expert in both!

Thanks to you, I'm confident I'll be able
to keep inventing for many years to
come. Feel free to come to me with any
machinery-related problems in future!

Th-th-thank you for telling me about the fish
and about my predicament! I'll give up this
time, but next time let's go catch the master
of Coolley Lake together!

My husband's fishing obsession hasn't changed,
but thanks to you he thinks a little more about
the shop and me now. Maybe I'll be a little
kinder to him from now on.

To think I'd make a new tea-drinking friend at
my age. I suppose I'm not ready to grow old yet.
Now then, I think I'll help my unworthy
apprentice build that ship first.

My Divine Beast ship is complete, and it's all
thanks to you! Now, if the unthinkable
happens, I'll ferry Aurium's people out
of Iira and to safety. Count on it!

Never thought I'd see the day I'd get
told off by my own daughter. But me
and her, we've got our own paths.
Thanks for showing me that.

Imperial Forest Road is my favorite walking route.
Thank you so much. Those four brothers aren't
bad kids, but I worry about them, so please
keep an eye on them.

Resistance Army training is tough, but being
useful to someone isn't so bad, mo! Ryuuryuu
will keep working hard here with the younger
brothers, so you all work hard too, mo!

I finally got the job I've always wanted! The
vice-captain is even stricter than I imagined,
but I'll push through with grit and become
someone strong who can protect everyone like you.

I still can't accept my master's death, but I'm
ready to inherit the skills and ideals left
behind. Everyone, thank you for conveying my
master's feelings to me.

Adel-sama! Splendid work! The gardens have
regained the beauty they had before Heaven's
Holy Grail attacked. The people of the capital
must be grateful too.

Thanks to all of you, that fool son of mine has
improved a little. Someday I'll build you the
finest garden—together with that fool son.

Thanks to all of you, I've overcome my grief
and can face my cooking again. Please come by
someday and try our specialty, the Tricolor
Mottled Roll.

For the first time in ages, the haze over my
heart has cleared a little. I lived only to avenge
my younger sister, but now I'll work with Dio
to wipe out the Bloody Lobsters.

You solved a problem troubling Seiryuu-sama,
who has lived for over 800 years? Impressive!
But what caused that monster to attack him in
the first place?

Thanks to you, I safely delivered the money to
the big person, mo! Thank you, mo! MnP is really
useful, mo! Maybe I should try selling it as a
product next time, mo?

Thanks to all of you, I can express true love
through my lute! Thank you so much! Ahh, love
really is wonderful...!

I should learn a little from Leon's earnestness.
And thank you from the bottom of my heart for
saving that idiot—my partner.

My Comprehensive Guide to the Unique
Monsters of Alst is ready at long last!
Thanks for your help, everyone!
...Any suggestions for my next guide?

Chairman Morumo seems even more motivated than
usual, mo! Popolo will support him with all his
might, mo! But not around the clock, so maybe
about 30 minutes a day, mo.

I never thought I'd be able to live with Teo
again at my age. May Acedia's blessing go with
all of you on the road ahead...

All right! From now on I'll follow your example
and guard the warehouse seriously! So Adel-sama,
please don't tell the squad leader that I was
slacking off!

It's thanks to all of you that I can watch the
fish swimming around so energetically. Thank you.
I'll take responsibility for raising the fish you
gave me with great care.

Kozel's cooking was excellent, of course, but
Shin's and Hikari's were fantastic too! Someday
I'll start a revolution in Superbian cuisine
myself!

Thank you for all the delicious food, mo! It
seems Morimori got a little bigger, but Morimori
doesn't mind, mo! Morimori is still growing,
after all, mo!

Thanks for talking to the traveling performer,
mo! Now Rikoko is a proper traveling performer
too, mo! Please come and hear Rikoko and the
others perform sometime, mo!

Jericho really resembles his younger sister,
Brigitta—especially that pushy streak. I'll keep
working as a handyman and atoning for what I did.
You all do what you have to do, too.

I can never thank you enough for the Dragon
Incense you gave us. My daughter is well again.
Adel-sama, please take good care of your wife
and child too.

Thank you for bringing Kei and Kai back. From
now on, I'll do my best to live on with the
children for Nei's sake, too.

The medicinal herbs you delivered let us save
many people. My deepest thanks. As expected of
Prince Adel—you truly are a man worthy of
bearing Iira on your shoulders.

Thanks to all of you, we delivered the food to
Aletta safely. You really helped us! And of
course I haven't been snacking on it. Munch...
gulp.

Thanks for delivering so much food! From now on,
we'll solve the Resistance Army's problems
without relying on your help—as long as we have
our secret booze and snacks!

Next time I visit my grandmother, I'll tell her
all about Adel-sama and all of you. Better yet,
I'll write a book so this debt of gratitude is
passed down for generations!

We believe in the future Adel-sama and all of
you will create! Karina and I may not be much,
but nobody can beat our faith in Adel-sama!

The people Adel-sama recruited have been doing
well since then. While Adel-sama is away, I, the
Resistance Army's vice-captain, will protect it,
so please rest easy!

Noel and I still have a long way to go, but
we'll work hard to be useful to the Resistance
Army. So please beat Metsu to a pulp!

I never thought Dad was alive! Honestly, I was
worried I couldn't protect Kei alone, but we'll
be all right with Dad here. Nii-chan, Onee-chan
and everyone—thank you!

Onee-chan and everyone, thank you for finding
our father! You're all so kind. Come to think of
it, Aunt Ranea was very kind too...

Thanks for helping Dodon with the dream of
making a fortune, mo! Mo-mo? Come to think of
it, how much is a fortune, mo? About 1,000 pieces
of Dodon's favorite meat, mo?

That greenhorn became respectable before I knew
it. Building a Divine Beast ship to save people,
eh? That kind of recklessness is just like the
old master. I don't dislike it.

Thanks to all of you, I feel like I've grown a
little as a Driver~ From now on, Kaede-chan and
I will travel to all kinds of places and keep
doing our best~

Thanks to you, Rita has taken her first step as
a Driver. It's a long road, but someday we'd like
to become a Driver and Blade like all of you.

The machine parts you gathered were
a huge help. I even repaired my Search
Machine with the spare parts. Thank you.

Thanks to all of you, it looks like I can keep
researching the Ether miasma, yes. And Blades
that can manipulate Ether are fascinating. I'd
like to research them next, yes.

Thank you for protecting Punpun's napping spot,
mo! If you're ever in trouble, let Punpun know,
mo. Punpun can at least help pull weeds, mo!

Thanks to Laura and the others, the legend of the
Dana Desert has been unraveled. I'll chase the
next legend, so you all keep at it too!

Sincerest thanks for reuniting Mirei
and me. We don't have long left, but
I'll make the most of our final days so
I've no regrets when the time comes...

Thanks for defeating the monsters! My family
works as gardeners in the capital, so if you're
ever nearby, come and say hello!

Thank you for proving the treasure map I bought
from the Nopon was real. Apparently they'll offer
me a map to an island where golden fruit grows
next, so I'm going to take on that one too!

The monsters have been getting more violent
lately, so I'm glad you helped. Thanks to you, my
son and I can make a living. I do feel bad about
what I did to the old innkeeper, though.

To think you found the treasure hidden by Kevi
Seal! I knew you were the right people. There are
Sealstones all across Iira, so try looking for
them.

Adel-sama is far too soft for forgiving Morumo
after he misused the red pollen orbs, mo! But
that's exactly why Makumaku and everyone admire
Adel-sama and follow him, mo!

How humiliating... this outfit... Still, you gave
me this life. From now on, I'll look for a better
way to live in the capital than being a spy...

Thanks to your efforts, Majesty, our
nation's ties with Gula will grow
stronger than ever... Also, is there any
chance of getting more of that honey...?

Meknes's death is regrettable, but I'm glad I
learned the truth rather than never knowing. From
now on, I'll work even harder at my duties for
his sake.

Someday I'll become a soldier praised by
generations of Superbians to come! One who can
rival all of you! And when that day comes, fight
me again!

Ahh, that was truly wonderful food. Now I can put
even more effort into maintaining the Royal Ship!
If you ever come to Superbia, next time I'll treat
you to food from my homeland!

Truly, I am humbled by your kindness.
I shall strive henceforth to maintain
positive relations between Gula
and Superbia, I swear it...

Rita has promise, doesn't she? I've become a bit
of a fan. Before I go to the Kingdom of Invidia,
I plan to stop by Iira and say hello.

Honestly, getting the title of Knight of Iira is
amazing! But getting the title isn't the goal.
Let's keep pushing each other to greater heights!

I wonder if Kei and Kai are living happily with
their father now. From now on, I'll make all of
you my goal and learn to act for someone else's
sake too.

I'm jealous—you became a Knight of Iira. But you
and I are friends, so that means I'm a Knight of
Iira too, right? No? Harsh. I suppose that's the
whip of love.

Dorara is happy to be friends with amazing
Drivers and Blades like all of you, mo! Dorara
wants to become a Driver even more than before,
mo!

Adel-sama... Please beat Metsu and come back!
Sata and I will be waiting for you! And for
Kasumi-san too...

Everyone better come back soon.
Sitting around and waiting is so
boring. I hate it.

You've all helped us so much. The future of
Iira—no, of Alst—rests on your shoulders.
We're counting on you.

Thanks for helping my dad out
before! My belly was full and happy
for the first time in a long while!

Adel-sama, Laura-sama... Please protect the
Kingdom of Iira. With the power of Heaven's Holy
Grail and Iira's treasure, you will surely be
able to defeat Metsu.

No emperor in the history of Superbia has ever garnered this much
trust and respect from foreigners...
Emperor Yuugo, luck be with you, sire!

Thanks for putting up with my old man's hobby.
He's an eccentric who only thinks about inventions
and doesn't even know I became a helmsman. He's
heartless, but family is family.

To think you defeated all the golden monsters...
Maybe losing my chance at eternity wasn't entirely
a waste after all, since I got to meet strong people
like you.

Sorry about that mission, mo! But even Gororo, a
combat professional, thinks you should be able to
beat any opponent now, mo! Gororo has high hopes
for you, mo!

My Driver was rude to you. Still, being able to
see your impressive skill made this a very
meaningful time. We must work hard so we don't
lose to you either.
